lines.hello: Oh! Hello, hello! Sorry, I was miles away. Come in, come in.
lines.welcome: Welcome to the world of Pokémon!
lines.myName: I'm Elm. Most people just call me the Pokémon Professor, though I'm still young enough to blush at it.
lines.world: Pokémon live everywhere you can think of: in the long grass, out at sea, deep in caves and high up on the wind.
lines.oneOfThem: This little one is a Pokémon too. See how it bounces?
lines.liveAlongside: People and Pokémon look out for each other. Some share a home, and some train together and battle side by side.
lines.study: My own work is on how Pokémon grow and change. Every day turns up a new puzzle.
lines.enough: But listen to me going on! I'd rather hear about you.
lines.boyOrGirl: Are you a boy, or are you a girl?
lines.nextDoor: There's another young trainer I keep hearing about. Rather sharp, by all accounts, and never far behind anyone.
lines.neverStill: What did they say his name was? It's on the tip of my tongue...
lines.ofCourse: {rival}! That was it. I'm sure your paths will cross.
lines.story: {name}, a journey all your own starts today. You'll find friends, rivals and a great deal to learn.
lines.offYouGo: Off you go, then. Johto is waiting for you!
